categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Solartron Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of polymer functional films including reflective films, optical base films, lithium-ion battery separators, and other special functional films. These products are widely applied in LCD displays, power batteries and energy storage, and solar photovoltaic industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer film technologies such as biaxial stretching of polyester films, precision coating, multi-layer polymer and metal film composite technologies, and proprietary formula designs to achieve high reflectivity and performance. It has developed unique electrolyte base membranes for solid and semi-solid batteries with high porosity and compressibility, and employs customized production lines and equipment designed in-house to reduce costs and improve efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international electronics manufacturers such as Samsung, LG, and BOE, serving industries like flat panel displays (LCD, Mini LED), semiconductor lighting, new energy vehicles, energy storage, and solar photovoltaic. The company targets high-end display and battery markets with a focus on import substitution and expanding market share globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with subsidiaries in Ningbo, Hefei, Shanghai, and Zhoushan, and has a sales and trade subsidiary in Hong Kong. Its customer base and sales extend internationally, including significant partnerships with South Korean and Japanese electronics firms.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Solartron Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing specialized polymer films and membranes that serve as critical components for downstream industries such as display panel manufacturers, battery producers, and photovoltaic module assemblers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment focusing on enhancing core products like reflective films and optical base films, and developing strategic emerging products such as solid and semi-solid electrolyte base membranes and transparent polyimide (CPI) films. It aims to achieve technological leadership, import substitution, and expand applications in new display technologies, semiconductor, 5G, and new energy sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of functional films and membranes to industrial customers. The company also engages in some distribution via selected dealers to broaden market reach. Revenue streams include sales of reflective films, optical base films, battery separators, and photovoltaic encapsulation films.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading global player in the optical reflective film segment, ranking first worldwide in shipment area. It competes with international giants such as Toray, Teijin, and SKC in battery separators and optical films. The company leverages proprietary technology and cost advantages to strengthen its market position and pursue import substitution in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.34 billion, a 6.62% increase year-over-year, but recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 29.44 million due to capacity ramp-up costs and intensified competition. Total assets reached RMB 3.38 billion with a slight growth of 1.37%. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures accounting for 4.61% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Solartron Technology differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies, including high-reflectivity multi-phase porous structures in reflective films, precision coating processes, and customized production equipment that reduce costs and improve product quality. Its products meet stringent performance requirements for high-end display and battery applications, supporting import substitution and offering comprehensive functional film solutions tailored to customer needs.
